title: Class D departure: ground and tower

briefing.description: First towered-field departure. You'll listen to the ATIS, call Ground for taxi with the ATIS code, read back your taxi instructions, then call Tower when you're ready to go — and read back your clearance word for word. Runway assignments and hold-short instructions must always be read back.
briefing.atisText: Centerville Regional information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Sky clear. Altimeter {altimeter}. Landing and departing runway {rwy}. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.

steps.speaker: ATIS
steps.text: Centerville Regional information {atis}. Wind {wind_dir} at {wind_kt}. Visibility one zero. Sky clear. Altimeter {altimeter}. Landing and departing runway {rwy}. Advise on initial contact you have information {atis}.
You copy the ATIS and switch to Ground, 121.7.

steps.prompt: Call Ground for taxi. You're at the main ramp, VFR to the practice area, and you have information {atis}.
steps.hint: Centerville Ground, Skyhawk {callsign}, at the main ramp with information {atis}, ready to taxi, VFR to the practice area.

elements.label: addressing Centerville Ground
elements.feedbackMissing: Address the facility first: “Centerville Ground”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your full callsign on initial contact.

elements.label: your position on the field
elements.feedbackMissing: Tell Ground where you are on the airport — “at the main ramp”.

elements.label: the ATIS code
elements.feedbackMissing: Report the ATIS: “with information {atis}”. It saves the controller reading you the weather.
elements.feedbackWrong: You said information {heard}, but the current ATIS is {atis}.

elements.label: the taxi request
elements.feedbackMissing: Say what you want: “ready to taxi, VFR to the practice area”.

steps.speaker: Ground
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, Centerville Ground, runway {rwy}, taxi via alpha.

elements.label: runway assignment readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You forgot to read back the runway assignment — runway assignments must always be read back.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but Ground assigned runway {rwy}.

elements.label: taxi route readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the taxi route: “via alpha”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End readbacks with your callsign so the controller knows who's answering.

steps.text: You taxi via Alpha and complete your run-up. Now holding short of runway {rwy}, you switch to Tower, 118.3.

steps.prompt: Call Tower — you're holding short of runway {rwy}, ready for departure.
steps.hint: Centerville Tower, Skyhawk {callsign}, holding short runway {rwy}, ready for departure.

elements.label: addressing Centerville Tower
elements.feedbackMissing: Address the facility: “Centerville Tower”.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Include your callsign.

elements.label: holding short report
elements.feedbackMissing: Tell Tower where you are: “holding short runway {rwy}”.

elements.label: ready for departure
elements.feedbackMissing: State your request: “ready for departure”.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, hold short runway {rwy}, landing traffic.

steps.prompt: Tower told you to hold short. Hold-short instructions require a full readback.

elements.label: hold-short readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Hold-short instructions must be read back word for word: “hold short runway {rwy}”. “Roger” is not enough.

elements.label: the runway
elements.feedbackMissing: Include the runway in the hold-short readback.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but the instruction was for runway {rwy}.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.text: A Cherokee floats past and lands. It clears the runway at the far end.

elements.label: takeoff clearance readback
elements.feedbackMissing: Read back the clearance itself: “cleared for takeoff”.

elements.label: runway readback
elements.feedbackMissing: You forgot to read back the runway — runway assignments must always be read back.
elements.feedbackWrong: You read back runway {heard}, but you were cleared on runway {rwy}.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: End the readback with your callsign.

steps.text: You take the runway and depart. Climbing through 1,500 feet, Tower calls you.

steps.speaker: Tower
steps.text: Skyhawk {callsign}, frequency change approved. Good day.

steps.hint: Frequency change approved, Skyhawk {callsign}. Good day.

elements.label: frequency change acknowledgment
elements.feedbackMissing: Acknowledge the instruction — “frequency change approved” or at minimum your callsign.

elements.label: your callsign
elements.feedbackMissing: Every acknowledgment needs your callsign.
